name: HeightSortChain
description: Height sorting on a chain transfer: short boxes go straight on, medium ones right, tall ones left, nine boxes.

local.name: State
local.comment: One state per step: 0 idle, 1 wait for a box, 2 straight on (short), 3 lift, 4 slide sideways, 5 lower

local.name: Dir
local.comment: Where the box goes: 0 short (straight), 1 medium (right), 2 tall (left)

local.name: SawLow
local.comment: The box broke the low beam

local.name: SawHigh
local.comment: The box broke the high beam

local.name: Stand
local.comment: A box must stand still against the blade before anything moves

local.name: Clear
local.comment: Time for a short box to cross the module

local.name: Lifted
local.comment: A moment at the top before the module slides a box

local.name: Slide
local.comment: Time to slide a box off the module

inputs.name: Low
inputs.comment: BeamLow.detect: the low beam (0.25 m) is broken

inputs.name: High
inputs.comment: BeamHigh.detect: the high beam (0.35 m) is broken

inputs.name: AtBlade
inputs.comment: EyeBlade.detect: a box waits against the blade

inputs.name: Raised
inputs.comment: Chain1.raised: the chain module is up

inputs.name: Lowered
inputs.comment: Chain1.lowered: the chain module is down

outputs.name: RunChain
outputs.comment: Chain1.run: run the chain module surface

outputs.name: MoveRight
outputs.comment: Chain1.right: slide the chain module right

outputs.name: MoveLeft
outputs.comment: Chain1.left: slide the chain module left

outputs.name: RunStraight
outputs.comment: Straight.run: run the belt to the short bin

outputs.name: RunRight
outputs.comment: RightBelt.run: run the belt to the medium bin

outputs.name: RunLeft
outputs.comment: LeftBelt.run: run the belt to the tall bin

outputs.name: Hold
outputs.comment: Blade1.extend: the blade holds the box while true

outputs.name: Done
outputs.comment: Beacon.green: all nine boxes are handled

rungs.comment: Start: a press latches the line on.
Low beam: the latch keeps what the box showed while it passed.
High beam: the latch keeps what the box showed while it passed.
Stand time: the box must stand still against the blade before anything moves.
Clear time: a short box crosses the module.
Lifted time: a moment at the top before the module slides a box.
Slide time: time to slide a box off the module.
Count a box when a short one has crossed or the module is back down.
State 5, lower: when the module is down, wait for the next box.
State 4, slide: when the box has gone, lower.
State 3, lift: when the module has been up for a moment, slide.
State 2, straight on: when the short box has crossed, wait for the next box.
State 1, tall box: it broke the high beam, so it goes left.
State 1, medium box: it broke only the low beam, so it goes right.
State 1, short box: it broke neither beam, so it goes straight on.
State 1, short box: straight on.
State 1, tall or medium box: lift.
The next box passes the beams before this one is done: clear the low latch now, when the decision is made.
The next box passes the beams before this one is done: clear the high latch now, when the decision is made.
State 0, idle: the start moves the line to wait for a box.
The infeed belt runs while the line is active.
The straight belt runs while the line is active.
The right belt runs while the line is active.
The left belt runs while the line is active.
The module carries a box straight on while it is down; with lift it must not run (a conflict).
The blade holds every box except a short one crossing the module.
Lift: the module is up while it lifts and slides.
MoveRight: slide right for a medium box.
MoveLeft: slide left for a tall box.
Done: lit when nine boxes are handled.
Busy: lit while the line runs and not yet done.
